*******************************************************************
* CYANIDE ADDITION KG/T SETPOINT CONVERSION
*
* This calc takes operator kg/t setpoint and convert it to a
* l/min flow setpoint for cyanide.
*
* Inputs
* RV : kg/t Cyanide Setpoint
* RV1 : Total Mass flow
* Locals
* P01 : Cyanide Conversion Factor
* This varies by season - Winter 28.5% => 0.3410
* Summer 30.5% => 0.3605
* P08 : Kg/t Max Setpoint
*
* Outputs
* CPV : FIC l/min setpoint
* CPV1 : Back calculate AIC MV when controller tracking
*
*******************************************************************
alias MASSFL FIC30378CALC.RV1
alias CYNFCT FIC30378CALC.P01
* Backcalculate kg/t from l/min setpoint for tracking, set at 0 kg/t if no massflow
if (MASSFL > 0) then
P02 = (FIC30378.SV*(60*CYNFCT))/MASSFL
else
P02 = 0
end if
* Clamp backcalculated kg/t
if (P02 > 10) then
CPV = 10
else
CPV = P02
end if
if (MASSFL < 10) then
FIC30378AS.SW = 2
else
FIC30378AS.SW = 1
if ({FIC30378.PV=CAL} <> 1) {FIC30378.MODE.CAS} = 1
end if
if ({FIC30378AS.MODE.AUT} <> 1 AND {FIC30378AS.ALRM.OOP} <> 1) then
{FIC30378AS.MODE.AUT} = 1
end if
if (({MIC30378.MODE.AUT}==1) AND (MIC30378.SV > P08)) then
MIC30378.SV = P08
end if
FlowHI = FIC30378CALC.P03 * 1.2
FlowHH = FlowHI + 1.5
P07 = P06 + 1.5
FIC30378.PH = dmax(P06,FlowHI)
FIC30378.HH = dmax(P07,FlowHH)

*******************************************************************

*
* This calc takes operator kg/t setpoint and convert it to a
* l/min flow setpoint for cyanide.
*
* Inputs

goto A1
end if
* l/min setpoint calculation for FIC, limit to low of 2 l/min

if (({FIC30378.MODE.CAS}<>1) AND (FIC30378AS.SW == 2)) then
AIC30381TSW.PV=1
else
AIC30381TSW.PV=0
end if

* Backcalculate kg/t from l/min setpoint for tracking, set at 0 kg/t if no massflow
if (MASSFL > 0) then
P02 = (FIC30378.PV*(60*P01))/MASSFL
else
P02 = 0
end if
* Clamp backcalculated kg/t
if (P02 > 10) then
CPV1 = 10
else
CPV1 = P02
end if

1:CCST;
************************************************************************************
* The CALCU calculates a standard deviation and is used for reporting only *
* The calculation is based on a formula below : *
* *
_ _ _ _ _ _
* (x1-x)*(x1-x)+(x2-x)*(x2-x)+...+(xn-x)*(xn-x) *
* standard deviation = SQRT ( --------------------------------------------- ) *
* n-1 *
************************************************************************************
program
double x, avg, sum, sum1
* n - number of samples
* x - sum to calculate the 'avg' average
* sum - sum calculation
* P01 - standard deviation
alias GS00602 GS00602-105.PV
if (GS00602==1) then
n = n + 1
x = x + AIC30381.PV
avg = x/n
sum = sum + (AIC30381.PV-avg)*(AIC30381.PV-avg)
* To make sure there is no division by 0
if (n >= 2) then
sum1 = sum/(n-1)
end if
P01 = sqrt(sum1)
P02 = avg
end if
end
